blocks.text: Paramount has acquired film rights to Pierce Brown ‘s New York Times bestselling sci-fi book series Red Rising , enlisting Francis Lawrence to direct an adaptation of the first installment, Deadline can confirm.

Justin Rhodes , a writer-producer with credits like Terminator: Dark Fate and the Prime Video series Secret Level , will write the script. Lawrence and Cameron MacConomy will produce for about:blank alongside Francesco Goedhuis, with author Brown executive producing.

blocks.text: Red Rising follows Darrow, a “Red” miner on Mars who discovers his people have been enslaved by the ruling Gold caste. After being remade to infiltrate Gold society, he joins a rebellion seeking to overthrow his world’s color-based hierarchy.

The deal marks the latest high-profile book adaptation set up at Paramount, which releases a big-budget take on Tomi Adeyemi’s YA romantic fantasy novel Children of Blood and Bone on January 15, 2027. Others upcoming include Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow — in theaters November 12, 2027 — and The Midnight Library .

Best known for directing five Hunger Games films — including The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , out November 20 — Lawrence is coming off the Stephen King adaptation The Long Walk for Lionsgate. Most recently, he inked a deal with the same studio for Carry Me to My Grave , an adaptation of a recently published horror novel by Christopher Golden that he’s eyeing to direct and produce.
THR was first to the news of Red Rising .
